name: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited
source: Audited statements of cash flows, Northam Platinum Holdings Limited audited consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026, page 42 (PricewaterhouseCoopers, unmodified opinion), R000 scaled to rand: cash flows from operating activities 18,489,488 (2025: 4,736,488); cash flows from investing activities (5,666,219) (2025: (4,992,282)); cash flows from financing activities (6,055,094) (2025: (287,397)); increase/(decrease) in cash and cash equivalents 6,768,175 (2025: (543,191)); effects of exchange rate movements (17,390) (2025: (128)); cash at the beginning of the year 6,918,642 (2025: 7,461,961); cash at the end of the year 13,669,427 (2025: 6,918,642). Capital expenditure 5,850,573 is the statement's own additions to expand operations 3,445,328 plus additions to maintain operations 2,405,245, carried negative. Free cash flow 12,638,915 (2025: (231,207)) is operating cash flow plus capex. FY2024 to FY2021 columns were not re-derived in this pass and remain as previously stored; each still internalises operating plus investing plus financing equals the net change.
